OPEN LETTER TO;
THE SEPTEMBER 21, 2025
RALLYISTS & DEMONSTRATORS

FROM: THE NATIONAL MOVEMENT
FOR SYSTEM CHANGE

SEPTEMBER 20, 2025

DEAR FELLOW COUNTRYMEN:

 Thank you and congratulations for your awakening. It is about time.
 But don’t do your rally at the EDSA Shrine and at the Quirino Grandstand. You will not get the desired results there.

 Do it in the following places:1) MALACAŃANG; 2)  CAMP AGUINALDO; 3) PHILIPPINE ARMY HEADQUARTERS AT FORT BONIFACIO’ 4) PHILIPPINE MARINES HEADQUARTERS AT FORT BONIFACIO; 5) SENATE AT ITS OFFICE IN THE RECLAMATION AREA; AND 6) HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES AT THE BATASAN BUILDING.

 Why should you do it in the following places?

 IN MALACAŃG: Ask the President to use all his powers to arrest all persons involved in the flood control scandal; confiscate all their properties, moneys and bank accounts, including senators, congressmen, members of the cabinet and also all co-conspirators, and imprison them in isolated islands for the rest of their lives. He can do that under pertinent sections in Article 2 of the Constitution.

 IN MILITARY CAMPS: 1) Ask the military officers, especially their commanders, to protect the people and the State by joining the people in the rallies as that is their duty under section 3 of article 2 of the Constitution; 2) If the President refuses to arrest the criminals in the flood control scandals and confiscate their properties, moneys and bank accounts, ask the military officers, especially their commanders, to stop and withdraw supporting the President like what Defense Minister JUAN PONCE ENRILE and Philippine Constabulary Chief FIDEL V. RAMOS did leading to the fall of President FERDINAND EDRALIN MARCOS in EDSA 1 and 2) Armed Forces Chief of Staff GENERAL ANGELO “ANGIE” REYES’ withdrawal of support in EDSA 2 leading to the ouster of PRESIDENT JOSEPH ESTRADA.

 SENATE AND HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES: Ask the Senate President and the Speaker of the House of Representatives to turn over their erring members to the President.

 ARE THE ACTIONS MENTIONED IN THE PRECEDING
PARAGRAPHS AGAINST THE LAW?
 ABSOLUTELY NOT!  WHY? THEY ARE CONSISTENT AND PURSUANT TO THE ABOVE-MENTIONED PROVISIONS OF THE CONSTITUTION.

 DO NOT USE FORCE OR VIOLENCE! TALK TO THE PRESIDENT AND THE MILITARY LEADERS, SENATE PRESIDENT AND THE SPEAKER OF THE HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES PEACEFULLY! IF THEY DEFY THE CONSTITUTION AND THEY DO NOT LISTEN – LET US SUBMIT THE ISSUE TO THE PEOPLE OF THE COUNTRY AND LET THE CHIPS FALL WHERE THEY MAY.
-0-
